parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Iron is a transition element. A list of properties of iron is shown. ● Iron is a good conductor of electricity. ● Iron forms soluble salts. ● Iron forms coloured compounds. ● Iron has variable oxidation states. ● Iron acts as a catalyst. ● Iron forms a basic oxide.

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Steel consists mainly of iron. Iron forms rust when it reacts with water and oxygen. Magnesium blocks can be attached to the bottom of steel boats. The magnesium does not completely cover the steel.
